title.value: Formalizing locality for normative synaptic plasticity models
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the paper, providing an accurate representation of its central theme.
title.quote: Formalizing locality for normative synaptic plasticity models

extractions.description: This paper proposes a formal and operational definition of 'locality' in synaptic plasticity models, specifically within the context of biologically plausible learning algorithms derived from machine learning principles. The authors introduce S-locality, an architecture-independent definition of locality, and p-locality, an operationalized notion of locality based on adjacency in computational graphs. They use these frameworks to categorize and group existing plasticity models and explore their experimental predictions, aiming to improve biological plausibility tests and guide experimental verification of synaptic plasticity algorithms.
